value.rationale: Run-count statistics govern BWT run-length compressibility; the smallest mixed-color 3-marker ternary family is a canonical nonbinary sparse test class. Its odd-run population is a genuine qualitative break from the binary three-identical-marker spectrum, and the all-length rational joint data provides complete extrema, exact multiplicities and a high-run density law, not a chosen finite cutoff.
